What can I discover?


A warm welcome to Qatar! This land will capture your imagination like no other. You will feel East meet West, as tradition blends with modernity on your trip — from shopping in futuristic malls or the fragrant Souq Waqif, to exquisite Qatari architecture, canals and candy-coloured neighbourhoods.
There are breathtaking cultural destinations like the Museum of Islamic art, pristine beaches across over 500km of coastline, and adventurous challenges in the desert. Of course, you will find luxurious pampering and global cuisine for every palate. If nature tops your wishlist, Qatar is proud to show you its Arabian Oryx and rare species like the whale shark, hawksbill turtle and dugong.
